label: Same strict proper parts
definition: SameProperParts x y means for every object p, p<x iff p<y, in one fixed Mathlib partial order. Strict part uses the inherited order; no bottom/null object, overlap-profile equivalence or causal meaning is implicit. IsMin is Mathlib minimality: any object below x has x below it; in a partial order this excludes every strict predecessor. Composite is the existing existence of a strict predecessor, definition 9ec56dce-572e-5230-8247-6b3e994cb98a.
